## Summary

What does this change, and why? Link the issue if there is one.

## Tests

Which tests did you add or change? For output changes, say whether snapshots were updated.

## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build SkarpSharp.slnx` succeeds
- [ ] `dotnet test --solution SkarpSharp.slnx` passes
- [ ] Skarp's own gate passes (if the change is intended, `skarp baseline .` was run and `.skarp-baseline.json` is committed)
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased"
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is licensed under the MIT license
